summary: A status report on the network numbers and autonomous system numbers used in the Internet. As of 1 March 1987, the Network Information Center at SRI International took over assigning them, and this RFC records the assignments at the time of transfer. It was replaced by RFC 1020 and RFC 1117.

eli5.summary: It is a list of who owns which network addresses, written down on the day a new office started handing them out.

questions: who assigned internet network numbers in 1987
